records.evidence: Foundry misspells the Cavalier's 17th-level Master Tactician (Advanced Player's Guide). The Cavalier class grants this record at level 17 (pf1 packs/classes/cavalier.u1ed3H9xtYQXTP5v.yaml:74-75), and its body ("At 17th level, the cavalier receives an additional teamwork feat as a bonus feat ...") has the same words as that of the correctly spelled pf1/mvyIXBt01WtR0lM1 (only the markup of "teamwork feat" differs), which no class row grants. PCGen's Cavalier feature is KEY:Cavalier ~ Master Tactician (apg_abilities_class.lst:206, TYPE:CavalierClassFeatures, the same DESC), which the Cavalier gains at 17th level (apg_abilities_globalvar.lst:50); no PCGen line carries "Tacitician". The reviewed Cavalier schedule binds this key to that feature (scripts/catalog/pcgen/schedules-smite-challenge.ts, master-tactician, level 17). The same-named Divine Strategist (uc_abilities_class.lst:574) and Drill Sergeant (mtt_abilities_class.lst:45) features are other classes' and are not this record.
